headline: Eastern and Island Theaters Erupt as Central Fighting Cools
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline momentum has pivoted away from the central valleys toward volatile island and eastern theaters. Fighting in Linn of Mercy and Nevish Line has cooled sharply, while Godcrofts and Palantine Berm have erupted into furious contention, recording eleven and ten base ownership changes respectively over the last two hours across Fleecewatch, Ursa Base, Vendett, and Windburn Landing. In Marban Hollow, rapid exchanges around Checkpoint Bua drove six fresh base events, leaving two fortified strongpoints reduced to neutral ruins. Stlican Shelf remains engulfed in severe bloodshed, with mutual casualties accelerating past nineteen hundred in two hours as fighting renewed near Breaker Town. Concurrently, Farranac Coast sustained over twelve hundred casualties in a sudden flare-up over Transient Valley, while Weathered Expanse stabilized into an uneasy pause with four strategic bases left abandoned in no-man's-land. Callahan's Passage also reports heavy incoming troop deployments and rising casualties across fortified mountain lines.
